review_notes: Restored proposal, functionality document and complete canonical/rendered support.c evidence from the failed attempt. Independently verified all four proposed corrections and all four superseded claims. Existing names, eight retained facts and two retained links remain inherited without overrides; acceptance is not a fresh audit of those retained rows. Document and proposal agree. Numeric status meaning, extreme retry arithmetic and callee release/ownership safety remain explicitly deferred because the proposal makes no stronger claims.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical lines 116–196 confirm attempt initialization, polling threshold, command processing, candidate rejection, read/send error termination, retained successful replies and final kWaitACKError replacement. Deferring extreme unsigned-to-signed retry arithmetic is appropriate; the ordinary-count qualification avoids an unsupported universal guarantee.

Canonical lines 7–114 confirm request serialization, conditional read copying, replacement of mismatched iteration length, and unconditional accumulation after the guarded operations. The correction properly distinguishes accumulated lengths from successfully transferred bytes.

The canonical signature and parameter uses support the stated roles. Early validation precedes output initialization; count and io_result lack independent pointer checks. Lines 79–95 synthesize numeric status 1 locally. Deferring its enumerator meaning preserves the evidence boundary.

Canonical lines 7–196 support the unit-level serialization, reply handoff, release calls and corrected count semantics. The document explicitly defers failure-path release safety and ownership inside TRKProcessInput; neither is required to establish the visible calls or proposed correction.

contradictions.reason: The superseded retry claim incorrectly allowed unreadable replies to retry generally. Read failures leave error nonzero, release the candidate and prevent another outer-loop attempt; the terminal missing identifier then replaces the error with kWaitACKError.

The superseded function data-flow claim overstated actual transferred bytes. Iteration length is accumulated even after local failures, and an oversized read reply can replace that length without being copied.

The superseded inferred-type explanation overstated completed count and exclusively remote status. The outputs represent accumulated iteration lengths and status that local length checks can replace with numeric 1.

The superseded unit summary repeated the completed-byte-count guarantee. Conditional copying and unconditional length accumulation disprove that guarantee; the proposed unit summary resolves it consistently with the function facts and document.

unresolved: Accepted deferral: numeric replacement status 1 is preserved without assigning an unverified DSIOResult enumerator meaning.
Accepted deferral: extreme p2 behavior depends on unsigned addition and conversion to the signed attempt counter; no universal mathematical retry-count guarantee is asserted.

Accepted deferral: failure-path release safety and ownership inside TRKProcessInput require callee evidence. Acceptance establishes only the visible calls and handoffs, not callee lifetime guarantees.
